mails.subject: [wp-test-ai] Easy Form Builder could not install its language files
mails.body:
Easy Form Builder could not install its translation into Swedish (sv_SE) on http://localhost/wp-test-ai/.
This happened when the plugin was opened in the WordPress dashboard.
The plugin keeps working normally, in English, until the translation is installed.

What went wrong: the server this website runs on cannot connect to 127.0.0.1:9.
Technical detail: cURL error 7: Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 9 after 2042 ms: Couldn't connect to server

What you can do:
1. Ask your hosting provider to allow outgoing HTTPS connections (port 443) from this server to 127.0.0.1:9. The plugin installs the translation by itself as soon as it can connect.
2. Or install the translation yourself, in a few minutes:
   - Download Swedish (sv_SE): http://127.0.0.1:9/wp-json/wl/v1/translations/easy-form-builder/package/sv_SE
   - Unzip it and upload the files to wp-content/languages/plugins/ on your server, replacing any file with the same name.
   - Step-by-step guide: https://github.com/hassantafreshi/easy-form-builder/blob/HEAD/docs/language-packs/manual-install.md

You will not receive this email again for the same problem in the next 30 days.
